scientific_integrity: The finite checker corroborates an infinite proof via vertex-transitive graph connectivity and the simplicial nerve lemma; no computer output is used as a substitute for the theorem. Prior work supplies the disconnected-graph core and ambient nonequivariant homotopy.
scientific_limitations: Only complete regular cyclic and dihedral group fixed loci, not arbitrary subgroups or quotients.
